text:
maria_sales: Quick ask - HospCare's procurement sent a SIG-lite follow-up: they want an IAM evidence bundle for the POC zip (SAML metadata, MFA enforcement proof, RBAC export, and one representative service-account policy with rotation). They want it by COB tomorrow. Can we pull a sanitized set?

omeen_security: We can. Plan: export signed SAML metadata, an IdP conditional access screenshot showing MFA requirements, and a 30-day auth-event extract with principals hashed. Need to confirm redaction rules for patient-related metadata.

nina_se: For RBAC I'll create a CSV of role mappings and a short README.md describing scoping and least-privilege defaults. Columns: role_key, title, scope_pattern, allowed_actions, example_principal.

kevin_engineer: I'll include a minimal SCIM mapping snippet and an example machine-credential JSON we use in infra. Snippet: ```json
{
  "group_attr": "roles",
  "map": {"saml:role": "platform:role"}
}
```

maria_sales: Customers often ask: "do machines bypass MFA?" How do we phrase that succinctly?

omeen_security: We state: interactive logins are protected by IdP MFA and conditional access; non-interactive service principals authenticate with short-lived, scoped tokens with enforced rotation and limited TTLs. We'll include a control statement and the token-policy screenshot.

nina_se: Example RBAC row we'll supply: `ingest_writer,Ingest Writer,project:hospcare:data,[dataset:create,dataset:append],sa-ingest-01`. Also include a sample policy fragment showing denied actions by default.

pat_cs: I'll draft the cover note to the security reviewer listing artifacts and exact redactions. Offer a 20-30 minute tech walkthrough and Loom recording. Also remind them raw logs require DPA + extra NDA for PHI-sensitive exports.

omeen_security: Redaction checklist: replace emails with <user_hash>, remove tenant IDs, zero-out UUID suffixes, aggregate IPs to /24. I'll attach the scrub-script snippet in the bundle.

kevin_engineer: Sample machine credential (will redact IDs):
```
{
  "id": "sa-etl-77",
  "permissions": ["dataset:append"],
  "scoped_to": ["project:hospcare:etl"],
  "key_ttl_hours": 1,
  "rotation_policy_days": 7
}
```

maria_sales: Good. Also list IdPs we support so procurement can tick boxes.

omeen_security: We'll note: Okta, AzureAD, OneLogin, PingFederate. And add: MFA enforced at IdP OR via our conditional access integration; machine tokens subject to token policies.

nina_se: I'll attach a short CSV example and a one-page PDF explainer of RBAC best practices we follow (least privilege, role review cadence).

uploader-bot: upload complete -> staging/hospcare-iam-evidence-196543 -> SHA256: 12ab34cd... :white_check_mark:

pat_cs: Upload noted. Maria, once you send the bundle link, offer the walkthrough and note that full audit exports >30d require executed paperwork.

maria_sales: Will do. ETA: I'll email HospCare in the morning with the staging link and the cover note. Thanks team.

omeen_security: One more: if they request machine-auth logs with IP-level detail, we escalate to Legal for DPA confirmation.

maria_sales: Understood. Closing thread once message sent. :+1:
